changes.old_desc: Patch a workflow. Only include fields you want to change. Useful for tweaking step config, updating the trigger event, switching trigger types (e.g. from manual to entity_event), or rewording the name. To toggle active/paused state, prefer workflows_pause / workflows_resume. NOTE: changing triggerTy
changes.new_desc: Update a workflow; omitted fields are unchanged. `isActive: false` pauses it (runs in progress continue), true resumes. When switching triggerType, send the matching triggerEvent too. Shapes as in workflows_create.

changes.old_desc: Manually fire a workflow on a specific entity, bypassing its trigger. Useful for testing a workflow you just authored, or for one-off automations the user invokes by name (e.g. "run my onboarding workflow on John Doe"). The entity must already exist; the workflow's trigger context is synthesized as
changes.new_desc: Run a workflow now on one existing record, bypassing its trigger. Its steps really execute (texts, emails, webhooks), so confirm with the user.

changes.old_desc: List the user's workflows with their trigger summary, step count, active/paused state, and last-run timestamp. Use this to see what automations exist before creating new ones or before modifying an existing one.
changes.new_desc: List workflows (trigger, step count, active state, last run). Pass `id` for one workflow's full definition, or `id` with `runs: true` for its run history (newest first, with per-step results explaining skips and failures).

changes.old_desc: Soft-delete a workflow. DESTRUCTIVE — confirm with the user before calling unless they explicitly asked to delete.
changes.new_desc: Soft-delete a workflow. Confirm with the user first.

changes.old_desc: Create a workflow. `trigger_type` is one of "entity_event" (fires on contact.created etc.), "scheduled" (cron/one-time), "inbound_webhook" (when a Groundbase inbound webhook receives a POST), or "manual" (only fired by workflows_run_now). For entity_event, set trigger_event to e.g. "contact.created"
changes.new_desc: Create a workflow. triggerType entity_event needs triggerEvent (e.g. "contact.created", "deal.stage_changed"); scheduled needs triggerConfig; inbound_webhook needs triggerEvent = the inbound webhook id; manual runs only via workflows_run_now.

changes.old_desc: Drop a pre-recorded voicemail on a contact's voicemail box. The Worker initiates a Twilio call with machine-detection; Twilio waits for the voicemail to pick up, plays the audio, then hangs up. NEVER plays at a live person — if AMD detects a human, Twilio hangs up silently. Standard voice rates appl
changes.new_desc: Play a drop onto someone's voicemail via a real Twilio call (hangs up if a person answers), billed at Twilio voice rates on the user's account. Give contactId or toPhone. Confirm with the user first.

changes.old_desc: Create a new empty voicemail drop. It has no audio yet — follow up with voicemail_drops_generate_emma to give it Felicia's voice, or have the user record by phone in the app. Returns the new drop's id.
changes.new_desc: Create an empty voicemail drop. Give it audio with voicemail_drops_update `script`, or record by phone in the app.

changes.old_desc: Edit or delete one time entry. Set `delete: true` to delete. Otherwise pass only the fields to change. Hours and rate cannot change while the entry is on an issued invoice.
changes.new_desc: Edit a time entry (omitted fields unchanged), or delete it with `delete: true`. Hours and rate are locked while on an issued invoice.

changes.old_desc: Start the user's timer, optionally against a contact, company or deal. Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and saves the running one (returned as `stopped`). The rate is taken from `rate` or, if omitted, from the last rate used for that deal/contact/company.
changes.new_desc: Start the timer, optionally for a contact, company or deal. Starting stops and saves any running timer (returned as `stopped`). Rate defaults to the last one used for that customer.

changes.old_desc: Log time already spent, e.g. "2 hours on the Riverbend job yesterday". Give `duration` ("1:30", "90m", "1.5h" or a number of hours) and optionally `startedAt` (ISO 8601); without startedAt the entry ends now. Or give both `startedAt` and `endedAt`. Max 24 hours per entry.
changes.new_desc: Log time already spent: `duration` ("1:30", "90m", "1.5h" or hours) ending now or starting at `startedAt`, or `startedAt` + `endedAt`. Max 24h.

changes.old_desc: List time entries, newest first, with the running timer and totals by customer for the range. Filter by contactId, companyId or dealId, and by status "unbilled" (billable, stopped, not on a live invoice) or "billed". `from`/`to` are ISO 8601; the summary defaults to the last 30 days.
changes.new_desc: List time entries (newest first) plus the running timer and per-customer totals (default last 30 days). status "unbilled" = billable, stopped, not on a live invoice.

changes.old_desc: Patch a task. Only include fields to change. Recurrence can be turned on, changed, or removed here (pass an empty string to stop a task repeating).
changes.new_desc: Update a task. `status: "done"` completes it (a recurring task spawns its next occurrence). Omitted fields are unchanged; recurrence "" stops repeating.

changes.old_desc: List tasks/events/meetings for the user. Filter by `kind`, `status`, `contactId`, or date range. Defaults to showing open (status=open) items of all kinds.
changes.new_desc: List tasks, events and meetings (default: open items of every kind), or pass `id` to fetch one. Google Calendar events, when connected, are included as kind event.

changes.old_desc: Create a task, event, or meeting. • `task` — has dueAt + optional recurrence (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/weekdays). • `event` — has startAt + endAt. • `meeting` — has startAt + endAt + location. Title is required. Link to a contact (contactId), company (companyId), or deal (dealId).
changes.new_desc: Create a task (dueAt, optional recurrence), event (startAt/endAt) or meeting (startAt/endAt/location), optionally linked to a contact, company or deal.

changes.old_desc: Create a new tag. Name is required. Color is a hex string like "#B91C1C".
changes.new_desc: Create a tag.

changes.new_desc: Add a tag to many contacts at once, or take it off them with `remove: true`. Idempotent; returns how many changed.

changes.new_desc: The account's SMS suppression list (numbers never to text). action 'list'; 'add' records opt-outs from elsewhere (normalised to E.164, unreadable numbers reported back); 'remove' only when someone genuinely opted back in.

changes.new_desc: Cancel a scheduled text that has not been sent yet. Id from sms_list with scheduled: true.

Over-cap recipients wait for later days. Use to warm a new do

changes.new_desc: Save a filter as a named view. `filterJson` must use the app's filter format; copy the shape from saved_views_list rather than inventing one.

changes.old_desc: EMAIL an issued quote to the customer from the user's own address, with a link to a hosted page where they can accept it (and pay the deposit, if there is one). changes.new_desc: Email an issued quote with a link where the customer can accept (and pay any deposit). A real message to a third party; confirm first. Returns `view_url`.

changes.new_desc: List quotes with counts per status and open value per currency, or pass `id` for one quote with lines, totals, deposit and acceptance details.

changes.new_desc: Add a plain-text note to a contact, company or deal timeline. Pass exactly one of contactId / companyId / dealId.

changes.new_desc: Update invoice settings; omitted fields are unchanged. `nextNumber` can only move forward.

changes.new_desc: Who answers inbound calls, the owner or Frontdesk (Emma). get: hours, override, timezone, emma_enabled, mode_now (emma | ring_then_emma | ring_then_voicemail). set_hours: when the OWNER takes calls (rung first; Emma otherwise; none = Emma always). set_override: force a mode until a time. changes.new_desc: List email conversations in the connected mailboxes: subject, participants, date and snippet (no bodies).

changes.new_desc: Rename or recolour a stage (`id` plus name/color), or reorder the whole pipeline by passing `order`: EVERY stage id, left to right.

changes.new_desc: Add a pipeline stage. Mark the terminal stages with `isWon` / `isLost` (one of each per pipeline). Omit `position` to append.

changes.old_desc: List deals. Returns all open + closed deals with their stage, value, contact, and company. Use this to summarize pipeline, find a deal to update, or filter by stage / value.
changes.new_desc: List deals with stage, value, contact and company, or pass `id` to fetch one deal with its notes and tasks.

changes.old_desc: Create a deal. title + stageId required. valueCents is in CENTS (so $1,500 = 150000). Link to a contact via contactId or a company via companyId (you can also pass both).
changes.new_desc: Create a deal. `valueCents` is in cents ($1,500 = 150000). Stage ids come from deal_stages_list.

changes.old_desc: Rename a custom field or change its dropdown options. Cannot change `entity_type` or `field_key` (create a new field if you need either). Cannot change `type` (data integrity).
changes.new_desc: Rename, reorder or change the options of a custom field. entity_type, field_key and type cannot change.

changes.old_desc: Set or update a custom field value on a specific contact, company, or deal. Resolves the field by `field_key` — call custom_fields_list first if you need to know what keys are available.
changes.new_desc: Set a custom field value on one contact, company or deal by field_key. value null clears it.

changes.old_desc: List the user's defined custom fields. Call this
changes.new_desc: List custom field definitions: field_key (used in {{cf.<field_key>}} and custom_fields_set_value), name, type, options, entity_type.

changes.new_desc: Delete a custom field and every value stored in it. Irreversible; confirm with the user first.

changes.old_desc: Define a new custom field on contacts, companies, or deals. Use this when the user mentions tracking a piece of data the CRM doesn't have a built-in column for (e.g. "track each contact's loan amount", "add a 'referral source' field"). `field_key` is auto-generated from `name` (snake_case) unless pr
changes.new_desc: Define a custom field on contacts, companies or deals. field_key defaults to a snake_case slug of name and becomes a {{cf.<field_key>}} merge tag.

changes.old_desc: Patch an existing contact. Only include fields you want to change — omitted fields are left as-is. Pass an empty string to clear a field (vs. omitting it which keeps the current value).
changes.new_desc: Update a contact. Omitted fields are unchanged; an empty string clears a field.

changes.old_desc: List the user's contacts with optional search/pagination. Use this to find a contact before calling get/update/delete, or to summarize who's in the CRM. Defaults to 50 results; pass `limit` up to 200 for more.
changes.new_desc: Search contacts, or pass `id` to fetch one contact in full (tags, addresses, custom fields, recent activity).

changes.old_desc: Create a new contact. At minimum, provide first_name or last_name or email — at least one of those is required. Phone numbers should be E.164 (+1...) when known; the API will normalize.
changes.new_desc: Create a contact. Give at least one of firstName, lastName or email.
